settings.overviewDescription: Let members send confessions that are hidden from other members.

descriptions.mode: Review holds every confession for staff approval. Screened only holds the ones your AutoMod rules flag. Direct posts everything immediately.
descriptions.anonymity: Hidden lets staff reveal and ban the real member. Anonymous keeps no record that can be reversed, by anyone, ever. Choose before you turn this on, because changing it later breaks a promise your members relied on.
descriptions.channel: Where confessions are posted. In a forum channel, each confession becomes its own post.
descriptions.autoThread: Open a thread under every confession so members can discuss it. Has no effect in a forum channel, where every confession is already its own post.
descriptions.reviewChannel: Staff-only channel where confessions wait for approval and member reports arrive.
descriptions.reviewerRoles: Roles allowed to approve, reject and ban. Falls back to Manage Messages.
descriptions.logChannel: Where confession actions are recorded, including every reveal.
descriptions.cooldown: How long a member must wait between confessions and replies.
descriptions.minAccountAge: How old a Discord account must be to send confessions.
descriptions.minMemberAge: How long a member must have been in the server to send confessions.
descriptions.maxLength: Longest confession accepted, in characters. Discord's message limit caps this at 3800.
descriptions.maxPerDay: Confessions allowed per member in any 24 hour period. Replies don't count. 0 means unlimited.
descriptions.allowMedia: Allow an image link on a confession. Unavailable while anonymity is set to Anonymous, because an untraceable image leaves you with nobody to report.
descriptions.numbered: Show a running number on each confession.
descriptions.postJitter: Wait a random amount of time up to this long before posting. Without it, a confession that appears seconds after someone was typing is easy to trace back to them.
descriptions.blockedRoles: Members with these roles cannot send confessions.
descriptions.deleteAfter: Delete confessions automatically after this long. 0 keeps them forever.
descriptions.submitButton: Show a Submit a confession button under every confession, so members can send one without typing the command.
descriptions.design: Post confessions with a design you saved in the embed builder or component builder. Placeholders: {{list}}
